name: Suspicious Printer Driver Empty Manufacturer
description: Detects a suspicious printer driver installation with an empty Manufacturer value
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Alerts on legitimate printer drivers that do not set any more details in the Manufacturer value
query: ((registry.path:*\\Control\\Print\\Environments\\Windows\ x64\\Drivers* AND registry.path:*\\Manufacturer*) AND winlog.event_data.Details:\(Empty\)) AND (NOT (registry.path:*\\CutePDF\ Writer\ v4.0\\* OR (registry.path:(*\\VNC\ Printer\ \(PS\)\\* OR *\\VNC\ Printer\ \(UD\)\\*)) OR registry.path:*\\Version\-3\\PDF24\\*))
